texts: good. the check, the Keeper, the flame and midnight are all covered, and checking correctly leaves the flame unchanged.
good. the refilling, the reservoir, midnight and the half-mark as the endpoint are all covered, and half_mark also records that it is a kind of mark.
good. the trimming, the Keeper, the wick, the careful manner and the third watch are all covered.

mixed: nothing is lost — the carbonizing, the wick and the long burn it happens over are all recorded. The shortfall is reach: "A wick" is a single indefinite wick, so this reads as one particular wick carbonizing rather than as a fact about wicks in general, and it will never apply to any other wick. Write it as a bare plural to get the general rule: "Wicks carbonize over a long burn."
good. the extinguishing, the flame, dawn and the brass snuffer as the means are all covered, and brass_snuffer also records that it is a kind of snuffer.
good. the walk home is covered and "after dawn-out" is recorded as dawn-out coming before the walk, with no invented facts about the dawn-out itself.
